versions.changelog:
- Initial release of xiao-chuang-you-emotion.
- Activated when users discuss emotions, mood, stress, loneliness, or related topics.
- Provides gentle emotional support with an emphasis on empathy before advice.
- Offers guidance inspired by traditional Chinese wisdom and modern mindfulness methods.
- Includes core abilities in emotion regulation, daily mind care, and new Chinese-style self-growth.
- Does not provide psychological diagnosis or therapy; refers serious issues to professionals.
